skills.application: 核对BLUEPRINT主张、实现及证据，设计独立闭环与负控；不对论文打分或宣称新性能。

scope.semantic_review: Targeted call paths, not a claim of full manual line-by-line review.
scope.large_assets: Not downloaded or used; no real trained-checkpoint accuracy verification.

fixed_findings.problem: R0/R1 memory and calibrated P were not connected to the common causal rollout.
fixed_findings.evidence: tests/test_observation_rollout.py: counts P/Q once, one G branch, current/window equivalence, independent histories and paired noise.

fixed_findings.problem: The current-only rollout always supplied hold baseline to constant-velocity P.
fixed_findings.evidence: Nonzero startup reference velocity reaches calibrated P in both rollout interfaces.

fixed_findings.problem: Online packet frame ids and field boundaries were not checked by the rollout.
fixed_findings.evidence: Future frame packet rejected before P/G; 30 Hz ids advance by three per 10 Hz frame.

fixed_findings.problem: Utility label metadata omitted the task metric identity.
fixed_findings.evidence: Metric id persisted; production diagnostic sets world_smpl22_fk_mpjpe_mm_fixed_bootstrap_beta; unspecified calls remain diagnostics.

fixed_findings.problem: Standalone streaming rejected nonfinite observations even when the action suppressed them.
fixed_findings.evidence: Nonzero Flow output head/shared noise gives equal masked outputs; reenabling contaminated history fails without body commit.

fixed_findings.problem: Standalone training resume did not bind runtime source code.
fixed_findings.evidence: Nine source hashes in checkpoint/provenance; matching runs resume identically, changed source rejected.

remaining_findings.issue: Formal Q dataset, training/checkpoint/unit contract and trained Q weights remain absent.
R0 was not retrained for this four-action protocol; real oracle gain and closed-loop Q effect remain unknown.
S0-S3 adaptation to actual fixed R0 histories and causal t_clear_obs dependency tracking remain planned.
Standalone TAE compression, real-data Flow training, loss contributions and CUDA latency remain unverified.
Legacy observation-reference position scores use t>=40 while velocity uses adjacent pairs from t>=20; preserve old results and version future reevaluation.
The online rollout uses clean-prefix floor estimation; published legacy R0 numbers use known-floor protocol.
Labels still require external P/stats/data/codec/sampling provenance; metric id alone is not a full cache identity.

literature.purpose: Bounded helper retrieval for code-mechanism and evidence alignment, not an exhaustive new literature survey.
